llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文综述了3D挤出生物打印的基本原理和方法，但未涉及人工智能在生物打印中的具体应用。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a general review of extrusion bioprinting methods and does not incorporate AI into any bioprinting workflow stage, nor does it provide experimental validation or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 为3D挤出生物打印提供系统的方法学概述。
summary_zh.method: 综述了挤出生物打印的工艺步骤、材料要求和应用案例。
summary_zh.result: 总结了挤出生物打印的优势、局限性和未来方向。
summary_zh.validation: 基于文献调研，无原始实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: This primer provides a comprehensive overview of the methodology and applications of 3D extrusion bioprinting.
summary_en.method: The authors review the key process parameters, bioink properties, and crosslinking strategies essential for extrusion bioprinting.
summary_en.result: The paper summarizes current capabilities, limitations, and emerging trends in extrusion-based bioprinting for tissue engineering.
summary_en.validation: The review is based on literature analysis and does not include original experimental data.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了Ti-6Al-4V晶格结构的压缩性能与几何参数的关系，对生物医学植入物刚度匹配有参考价值，但未涉及应力遮蔽或骨整合评估。
llm.why_not_core: Does not explicitly link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, does not include fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索晶格结构几何参数对Ti-6Al-4V多孔材料压缩性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 增材制造不同几何参数的四组晶格结构，进行准静态压缩实验
summary_zh.result: 几何参数显著影响晶格结构的弹性模量和抗压强度，可实现刚度调控
summary_zh.validation: 实验测试结果与理论模型和数值模拟进行对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how varying geometric parameters of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V lattice structures affect their compressive responses for potential biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Four sets of lattice structures with different geometric parameters were fabricated via selective laser melting and subjected to quasi-static compression tests.
summary_en.result: Geometric parameters significantly influence the elastic modulus and compressive strength, enabling stiffness tailoring for implant design.
summary_en.validation: Experimental results were compared with analytical models and finite element simulations.

papers.title: Control of Anisotropic Crystallographic Texture in Powder Bed Fusion Additive Manufacturing of Metals and Ceramics—A Review
papers.abstract: Abstract Additive manufacturing (AM) enables the production of complex, net-shape geometries. Additionally, in AM of metal and ceramics, which has received less attention, the microstructure and texture of the product can be arbitrarily controlled by selecting appropriate process parameters, thereby enabling unprecedented superior properties. This paper discusses recent progress pertaining to texture evolution mechanisms and control methods, with an emphasis on selective laser melting. One of the unique characteristics of AM is that the texture can be varied as a function of position within the product by controlling the scan strategy. The transient behavior of the texture and the factor used to control it via the scan strategy are discussed. In addition, the texture evolution behavior of face- and body-centered cubic as well as noncubic materials is discussed. The importance of the crystallographic “multiplicity” of the preferential crystal growth direction is described to understand the evolution behavior of the texture in such materials.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文综述了金属和陶瓷粉末床熔融增材制造中的晶体织构控制，未涉及生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a review on crystallographic texture control in PBF AM; it does not address porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述通过工艺参数控制金属和陶瓷增材制造中晶体织构的方法与机理
summary_zh.method: 梳理了选择性激光熔化中扫描策略、材料类型对织构演变的影响机制
summary_zh.result: 总结了织构控制可实现位置依赖性各向异性性能，并讨论了多重性因子的作用
summary_zh.validation: 基于已有文献综合分析，无新实验验证

summary_en.motivation: This review aims to consolidate recent progress in controlling crystallographic texture in powder bed fusion additive manufacturing of metals and ceramics via process parameter selection.
summary_en.method: The paper discusses texture evolution mechanisms and control methods, focusing on scan strategy and its effect on texture in face-centered cubic, body-centered cubic, and noncubic materials.
summary_en.result: Crystallographic multiplicity of preferential growth direction is key to understanding texture evolution, enabling spatially varied texture within a single part.
summary_en.validation: The review synthesizes findings from published studies; no original experimental validation is presented.

papers.title: Experimental study of the effects of hypoxia simulator on osteointegration of titanium prosthesis in osteoporotic rats.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Poor osseointegration is the key reason for implant failure after arthroplasty,whether under osteoporotic or normal bone conditions. To date, osseointegration remains a major challenge. Recent studies have shown that deferoxamine (DFO) can accelerate osteogenesis by activating the hypoxia signaling pathway. The purpose of this study was to test the following hypothesis: after knee replacement, intra-articular injection of DFO will promote osteogenesis and osseointegration with a 3D printed titanium prosthesis in the bones of osteoporotic rats. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Ninety female Sprague-Dawley rats were used for the experiment. Ten rats were used to confirm the successful establishment of the osteoporosis model: five rats in the sham operation group and five rats in the ovariectomy group. After ovariectomy and knee arthroplasty were performed, the remaining 80 rats were randomly divided into DFO and control groups (n = 40 per group). The two groups were treated by intraarticular injection of DFO and saline respectively. After 2 weeks, polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and immunohistochemistry were used to evaluate the levels of HIF-1a, VEGF, and CD31. HIF-1a and VEGF have been shown to promote angiogenesis and bone regeneration, and CD31 is an important marker of angiogenesis. After 12 weeks, the specimens were examined by micro-computed tomography (micro-CT), biomechanics, and histopathology to evaluate osteogenesis and osseointegration. RESULTS: The results of PCR showed that the mRNA levels of VEGF and CD31 in the DFO group were significantly higher than those in the control group. The immunohistochemistry results indicated that positive cell expression of HIF-1a, VEGF, and CD31 in the DFO group was also higher. Compared with the control group, the micro-CT parameters of BMD, BV/TV, TB. N, and TB. Th were significantly higher. The maximal pull-out force and the bone-to-implant contact value were also higher. CONCLUSIONS: The local administration of DFO, which is used to activate the HIF-1a signaling pathway, can promote osteogenesis and osseointegration with a prosthesis in osteoporotic bone.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注药物促进骨质疏松大鼠中3D打印钛假体的骨整合，而非多孔结构设计、力学性能或LPBF工艺。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure design for stress shielding, LPBF fabrication with mechanical testing, fatigue behavior, or surface morphology characterization; it focuses on pharmacological enhancement of osseointegration in a rat model.

summary_zh.motivation: 验证去铁胺局部注射能否促进骨质疏松大鼠中3D打印钛假体的骨整合。
summary_zh.method: 卵巢切除大鼠膝关节置换后关节内注射DFO，通过PCR、免疫组化、micro-CT、生物力学和组织学评估。
summary_zh.result: DFO组VEGF、CD31 mRNA升高，micro-CT参数和拔出力、骨-植入物接触均优于对照组。
summary_zh.validation: 大鼠体内实验，多指标验证（分子、影像、力学、组织学）。

summary_en.motivation: To test whether intra-articular injection of deferoxamine promotes osteogenesis and osseointegration of a 3D-printed titanium prosthesis in osteoporotic rats.
summary_en.method: Ovariectomized rats underwent knee arthroplasty with 3D-printed titanium implants, followed by intra-articular DFO or saline injection; evaluation included PCR, immunohistochemistry, micro-CT, biomechanical pull-out testing, and histopathology at 2 and 12 weeks.
summary_en.result: DFO significantly upregulated HIF-1α, VEGF, and CD31 expression, improved micro-CT parameters (BMD, BV/TV, Tb.N, Tb.Th), increased maximal pull-out force, and enhanced bone-to-implant contact compared to controls.
summary_en.validation: In vivo rat model with multi-modal validation including molecular, imaging, mechanical, and histological endpoints.
